records.source: Masks saved in Time mode use 32-bit TIFFs with embedded cell lineage. Names and ancestry are stored inside the TIFF; existing files change only when saved. Each wheel step gives the selected label to the object under the pointer and saves edits before moving to the adjacent frame; moving the pointer alone changes nothing. Enable Time?

Varje steg med mushjulet ger objektet under pekaren den valda etiketten och sparar ändringarna innan det går vidare till den angränsande bildrutan; att bara flytta pekaren ändrar ingenting. Aktivera Tid?
